name: Hoppscotch
description: Open source API development ecosystem, alternative to Postman and Insomnia.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Postgres database URL

variables.name: Auth Tokens - JWT Secret
variables.description: JWT secret for authentication tokens

variables.name: Auth Tokens - Session Secret
variables.description: Session secret for authentication tokens

variables.name: Data Encryption Key
variables.description: Key for data encryption in database. Must be 32 characters.

variables.name: Redirect URL
variables.description: Redirect URL for authentication

variables.name: Whitelisted Origins
variables.description: Comma-separated list of whitelisted URLs for authentication. Include three ports used by Hoppscotch.

variables.name: Enabled Auth Providers
variables.description: Comma-separated list of enabled authentication providers. Options: GOOGLE, GITHUB, MICROSOFT, EMAIL

variables.name: Google Auth - Client ID
variables.description: Google OAuth client ID. Delete if not using Google authentication.

variables.name: Google Auth - Client Secret
variables.description: Google OAuth client secret. Delete if not using Google authentication.

variables.name: Google Auth - Callback URL
variables.description: Google OAuth callback URL. Delete if not using Google authentication.

variables.name: Google Auth - Scope
variables.description: Google OAuth scope. Delete if not using Google authentication.

variables.name: GitHub Auth - Client ID
variables.description: GitHub OAuth client ID. Delete if not using GitHub authentication.

variables.name: GitHub Auth - Client Secret
variables.description: GitHub OAuth client secret. Delete if not using GitHub authentication.

variables.name: GitHub Auth - Callback URL
variables.description: GitHub OAuth callback URL. Delete if not using GitHub authentication.

variables.name: GitHub Auth - Scope
variables.description: GitHub OAuth scope. Delete if not using GitHub authentication.

variables.name: Microsoft Auth - Client ID
variables.description: Microsoft OAuth client ID. Delete if not using Microsoft authentication.

variables.name: Microsoft Auth - Client Secret
variables.description: Microsoft OAuth client secret. Delete if not using Microsoft authentication.

variables.name: Microsoft Auth - Callback URL
variables.description: Microsoft OAuth callback URL. Delete if not using Microsoft authentication.

variables.name: Microsoft Auth - Scope
variables.description: Microsoft OAuth scope. Delete if not using Microsoft authentication.

variables.name: Microsoft Auth - Tenant
variables.description: Microsoft OAuth tenant. Delete if not using Microsoft authentication.

variables.name: Mailer - Enable
variables.description: Enable email sending for authentication.

variables.name: Mailer- Use Custom Configs
variables.description: Use custom SMTP configurations.

variables.name: Mailer - From Address
variables.description: Sender email address.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP URL
variables.description: SMTP server URL.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server host if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP server port if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP Secure
variables.description: SMTP secure connection if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP Username
variables.description: SMTP username if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Mailer - SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP password if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Mailer - TLS Reject Unauthorized
variables.description: Reject unauthorized TLS connections if custom configs is enabled.

variables.name: Frontend - Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for the application

variables.name: Frontend - Shortcode Base URL
variables.description: Base URL for shortcode sharing, can be the same as Base URL.

variables.name: Frontend - Admin URL
variables.description: Admin URL for the application

variables.name: Backend - GraphQL URL
variables.description: GraphQL URL for the application

variables.name: Backend - WebSockets URL
variables.description: WebSockets URL for the application

variables.name: Backend - API URL
variables.description: API URL for the application

variables.name: Rate Limit - TTL
variables.description: Time, in seconds, it takes to refresh the maximum number of requests being received

variables.name: Rate Limit - Max Requests
variables.description: Maximum number of requests per IP under the TTL

variables.name: Auth Tokens - Salt Complexity
variables.description: Salt complexity for authentication tokens

variables.name: Auth Tokens - Magic Link Token Validity
variables.description: Duration, in days, for magic link tokens

variables.name: Auth Tokens - Refresh Token Validity
variables.description: Duration, in milliseconds, for refresh tokens

variables.name: Auth Tokens - Access Token Validity
variables.description: Duration, in milliseconds, for access tokens

variables.name: Allow Secure Cookies
variables.description: Set to false if using http. Some auth providers may not support http requests and may stop working when set to false.

variables.name: Subpath Access Mode Port
variables.description: This is an optional variable that lets you specify an alternate port for the container’s endpoint when operating in subpath access mode. By default, this endpoint is exposed on port 80.

variables.name: Terms of Service Link
variables.description: Terms of service link

variables.name: Privacy Policy Link
variables.description: Privacy policy link

variables.name: App Title
variables.description: Title of the app

variables.name: Logo URL
variables.description: URL of the logo

variables.name: Gallery Column Count
variables.description: Number of columns in the gallery

variables.name: Allowed File Types
variables.description: Comma separated list of allowed file types

variables.name: Max File Size
variables.description: Maximum file size in MB

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Secret key to combat strangers uploading. Optional, but recommended.

variables.name: Disable Upload
variables.description: Disable the ability to upload files

variables.name: Disable QR Code
variables.description: Disable the sharable QR code

variables.name: Hide Secret Key from QR Code
variables.description: Hide the secret key from the QR code

variables.name: Disable Home Link
variables.description: Disable the home link
